reasons: Paraphrase of core-055 ('mastered is not inflatable: rec counts DISTINCT cards proven by recall — recall-grading the same card five times raises rec by at most 1'): the spec performs the identical 5-repeat-recall-on-one-card action and asserts the same wasProven dedup (rec 3→4 exactly once).

masteredCount flatness is derivable from core-027's recall gate (masteredCount counts rec>=3 decks; rec 3→4 changes no membership), and the first-read seed assertion re-tests core-046's boot({initialState}) rail — scaling the seed from 1 to 25 decks changes numbers, not the invariant.
Rejected on novelty only; the spec itself is well-built (classic-mode MC-rig guard, truth-rail grading).

Scaled paraphrase of core-046 ('boot({initialState}) seeds progress before the app reads storage ... visible at first read: prep and masteredCount'): the candidate's headline 'reads their whole career at first read' is the same first-read-seeding law with a bigger blob; belt-record-at-boot surfaces are already pinned by core-011 (completed-belt blob → row state) and core-015/069 (won row after reboot).
The no-migration-beat assertion is vacuous by the spec's own header ('the fx vocabulary has NO migration beat at all ... trivially green today'), and the live-first-hand tail is core-017's landing.
Residual novelty (cardsToday 0 with empty days map) is thin and is asserted more meaningfully by the sibling returner-day-counter-clean-restart spec.

Duplicates core-069's tail almost clause-for-clause: 'the row reads won, blue is unlocked, and blue's first lesson genuinely opens (deckOpen true, _posKey equal to its deckKey)' — the candidate asserts white test row 'won', blue row not data-locked, and blue lesson click → deckOpen/_posKey===deckKey, reached via a seeded persona instead of the played-through story; core-015 also already covers won-row + blue-unlocked persistence.
The only additions (all-white-unit-rows data-done census, _session resume-pointer read) do not change the invariant's substance — it remains the resume-point law core-069 already establishes.

Paraphrase of core-025 ('drilling refunds decision time, capped at 2 per window'): the spec asserts the IDENTICAL +2.5/+2.5/+0 per-grade deltas and the same three timer_refund beats carrying granted [true,true,false].

The only change is the persona (a prep=5 veteran vs a fresh visitor). The cap mechanism (`granted = d.refunds < 2`) reads only the current window's refunds counter and never touches mastery, so seeding prep=5 changes numbers-that-do-not-change, not the invariant — the same basis on which veteran-mastery-not-inflatable was rejected.
Well-built (frozen-clock discipline), but rejected on novelty only.

Duplicates the already-REJECTED returner-path-resume-point invariant and core-069's tail: white test 'won', white lessons done, blue U1 unlocked, blue lessons not done, blue test 'locked' is the same frontier-resume claim, reached from a seeded persona instead of a played-through story.

Its two halves are each already pinned: gen-w1-11 (holder-next-test-still-locked) covers white-won/blue-test-locked, and gen-w1-12 (holder-sequential-locks-resume-in-blue) covers the blue unit-ladder lock. Compositing them under a returner persona does not change the invariant's substance.
The spec's own @hyperspace tuple declares B='cross-belt', which is not a valid B axis (axes.B has no such value) and mismatches the candidate slug's claimed B='guard-limit'.

Paraphrase of core-065 ('rigged win -> victory_cascade + ladder_up (+1) ... a defense-expiry loss then emits defeat_drain and ladder_down (-1)'): the spec itself states it 'mirrors the GREEN core spec test 3 (stakes-impact.spec.ts:122-170)'.

The claimed additions — no reload between phases and the delta-identity (rankAfterWin-rank0 + rankFinal-rankAfterWin === 0, round-trip to rank0) — are arithmetic corollaries of the +1-then-1 that core-065 already fires in one flow; the returner persona does not alter the ladderMove mechanism.
Rejected on novelty; the spec's assertions are correct and well-built.

The grading assertions duplicate core-030 (wrong MC -> mc_wrong, no prep/stage credit, correct button revealed) and core-031 (correct MC -> +prep +stage + mc_correct + bonus_pumped), and the cardsToday-exactly-+1 bump duplicates gen-w1-05's mechanism.

The only differentiator is the multiBeltEndgame persona; belt wins never touch a card's `stage`, so 'graduation does not close the drill' reduces to 'stage is independent of belts.won' — scaling the persona, not a new invariant.
Well-built (truth-rail, distinct-card plan for the cardDone Set), but rejected on novelty.

Re-runs core-066's invariant ('first watchShort raises odds by exactly 4 with one film_first_look beat; a second watch leaves the delta at 4 and the beat count at 1') at a different lifecycle point. The spec re-asserts exactly that: +4 once, second watch no-op, film beat count stays 1.

The _filmLook[tech] latch is per-technique and untouched by belts.won/prep/rec, so the graduated persona changes numbers-that-do-not-change; the minor per-technique-isolation add-on does not change the invariant's substance. Same basis as the veteran-mastery-not-inflatable rejection.
Rejected on novelty only; assertions are faithful and structural.

Same invariant as gen-w1-06 (returner-ladder-independent-of-blob): ladder rank lives in bjj-neural-ladder independent of the progress blob, a win climbs to rank 2, and after a preserveStorage reload rank 2 survives in its own key while the belt record rides the blob unchanged.

The only changes are the whiteBeltHolder persona and strengthening the belt-record check from truthy (gen-w1-06) to value-equal, plus a 'blob has no ladder key' assertion — deepening the same two-records/two-keys/survive-reload invariant, not creating a new one.
Rejected on novelty; the spec itself is well-built.

Paraphrase of core-032 ('mastered only via recall: five consecutive MC corrects pin the card's stage at 2 with rec still 0, while recall-grading three distinct graduated cards raises rec to >=3 and masteredCount by >=1'): the spec performs the identical 5-MC-correct + 3-recall-grade action and asserts the same stage-2/rec-0/mint gate.

The only change is scaling the base from a casual 0->1 to a veteran 25->26; the spec's own docstring concedes it 'overlaps mc-flashcards.spec.ts:172'. Scaling the seed changes the count, not the invariant — the exact basis for the veteran-mastery-not-inflatable rejection.
Rejected on novelty; the truth-rail + studyFromSession choke are well-built.

Composite of two existing invariants with the SAME tuple as core-009 (L=fresh-visitor, F=graph-canvas, B=cross-feature). Phase 1 (pathDim true, _curriculumIdxSet size>50, at least one node outside) is core-009 verbatim.

Phase 2/3 (toggle to TREE clears _pathDim, return to PATH re-arms) is gen-w1-28's accepted invariant (fog is a PATH artifact that lifts in tree). Compositing core-009 + gen-w1-28 under the same fresh-visitor point does not create a new invariant.
Rejected on novelty; the spec assertions are faithful and structural, but the invariant paraphrases core-009 (fresh-visitor fog arm) and gen-w1-28 (tree lift).

Scaled paraphrase of gen-w1-25 (corrupt-blob-settings-persist-cleanly-after-heal): the spec's own docstring calls itself 'the clean-profile sibling'. The invariant (set mcMode='classic' -> v2 blob -> survives preserveStorage reload, JSON.parse succeeds, _progressBlob().v===2) is gen-w1-25's exact persistence claim minus the corruption to heal.

The load-bearing seam (set() stamps _settingsAt.mcMode as a number and _flushSave synchronously persists) is already pinned by core-056; the reload-survives-mcMode by gen-w1-25. Dropping the corrupt precondition changes setup, not substance.

Also the file @hyperspace declares theme='lifetime-journeys' while the candidate slug is onboard-themed — a tuple mismatch. Rejected on novelty; assertions faithful but duplicate gen-w1-25 + core-056.
Composite of already-pinned halves without new substance: migration seam = core-008; lesson rows done-from-prep-alone while units stay incomplete = gen-w1-02 via a v1 seed instead of a veteran seed.
Remaining clauses ledgered elsewhere: belt-test rows locked despite done lessons = gen-w1-17; blue data-locked on an unearned profile = core-002; belt_unlocked-only-on-test-win inside core-015.
The single unpinned atom (absent v1 units/belts staying {} through _loadProgress) is thin — same basis as the returner-comeback-boot rejection: changing the seed, not the invariant.

tests.title: PATH|TREE toggle: exists, defaults to path, persists
tests.invariant: With curriculum loaded the explorer defaults to _viewMode 'path' (path_opened beat, white belt row rendered), and clicking the tree toggle writes localStorage bjj_view_mode='tree' which still selects tree view after a preserveStorage reboot.

tests.title: locks: white open, blue locked, units sequential
tests.invariant: On a fresh profile the white belt row carries no data-locked attribute while the blue belt row has data-locked='1', and unit rows are sequential (first unlocked, second data-locked='1').

tests.title: lesson click flies the camera and opens the lesson deck session
tests.invariant: Clicking the first lesson row moves camTarget to within 60px of the lesson node's x/y, sets deckOpen true, and the study session's key list contains that lesson's deckKey.

tests.title: drilling a lesson to goal emits lesson_done and marks the row
tests.invariant: Drilling the first lesson's deck 3 times emits a lesson_done beat and the lesson row's data-done attribute reads '1'.

tests.title: checkpoint opens the MC quiz once all lessons are done (P2 semantics)
tests.invariant: With all unit-1 lessons seeded to goal, clicking the checkpoint row emits checkpoint_start, sets _checkpoint truthy, and renders a visible [data-mc-opt] quiz option.

tests.title: gi-only lesson is disabled in nogi and excluded from unit math
tests.invariant: After setGiMode('nogi') a gi-only lesson row renders data-live='0' and aria-disabled='true'.

tests.title: TREE view ignores locks entirely
tests.invariant: In TREE view the explorer renders zero [data-locked] and zero [data-lesson] elements.

tests.title: v1 progress blob migrates to v2 with rec grandfathered
tests.invariant: Booting with a v1 blob whose prep['Mount|Top']=3 yields rec['Mount|Top']==3 (grandfathered from prep) and _progressBlob().v==2.

tests.title: fog-of-war rail: non-curriculum nodes dim while path view is open
tests.invariant: While path view is open _curriculumIdxSet has more than 50 node indices, at least one node falls outside it, and the _pathDim fog flag is active.

tests.title: curriculum 404: app falls back to tree view without crashing
tests.invariant: When curriculum.json returns 404 the app boots with curriculum null, _viewMode 'tree', and more than 1000 ingested nodes (no crash).

tests.title: test row states: locked without progress, READY with a completed belt
tests.invariant: The white belt-test row's data-test-state reads 'locked' on a fresh profile and 'ready' when booted with a completed-white-belt blob.

tests.title: starting the test: beat, authored start position, authored move budget
tests.invariant: Starting the belt test emits belt_test_start and sets _beltTest.beltId to white, currentPos to the authored test.startNodeId, maxMoves to the authored test.maxMoves, and a computed pool of at least 5 names.

tests.title: engagement survival: _beltTest outlives clearEngagement; reset cancels cleanly
tests.invariant: resetRoll during a live belt test nulls _beltTest, burns no attempt (attempts==0), emits no belt_test_lost beat, and the path row returns to data-test-state 'ready'.

tests.title: strict submission pool: the opponent only attacks with belt vocabulary
tests.invariant: With at least one opponent_attack observed during the belt test, every attack's base technique name (lowercased, pre-' from ') is contained in _beltTest.names and the roll stays live (options, an active defense, or the test) afterward.

tests.title: win by tap: belt recorded, blue unlocks, ladder rides along, all persisted
tests.invariant: Winning the belt test by tap emits belt_test_won before roll_end plus belt_unlocked, records belts.won.white with moves>=0, advances the ladder rank by exactly 1, and after a preserveStorage reboot the row reads 'won' with the blue belt unlocked.

tests.title: points and losses: at the move limit the engine matches its own dominance call
tests.invariant: When the move limit expires the outcome matches the engine's own dominance verdict: belt_test_won carries byPoints=true with dominance >= the authored pointsWinDominance, otherwise belt_test_lost carries dominance below it, one attempt is burned, and the row shows 'retry'.

tests.title: golden path: land → read → drill → pick → hit
tests.invariant: A fresh landing deals >=3 options with land and options_dealt beats, drilling two cards raises a mid-odds option's displayed odds by >=11 points (monotone inside clamp zones) with bonus_pumped, and a rigged pick produces commit then impact_success with a non-empty roll trail.

tests.title: golden path replays deterministically (frame-exact)
tests.invariant: Two fresh boots running the identical rigged golden-path script produce deeply equal option lists, roll trails, and beat sequences.

tests.title: win path: rigged submission finish ends the roll
tests.invariant: Rigging a dealt submission to succeed emits the finish beat and the last roll_end beat's outcome is 'win'.

tests.title: one-beacon law: exactly one highlighted surface at every beat
tests.invariant: At the land, sheet-open, and post-drill sample points exactly one [data-beacon] element exists whose target steps options -> jit/execute -> execute, at most one exists after commit, and at least 3 beacon_moved beats were emitted.

tests.title: defense drama: caught → panic drill → escape odds pump → relief
tests.invariant: A rigged catch fires impact_fail, caught, and panic_drill_opened with a visible [data-panic] card and one .ng-vignette, grading the panic card strictly increases escapeOddsSnapshot() with escape_odds_pumped, and a rigged escape reaches relief with the escape beat and the vignette element cleared.

tests.title: guided first roll: 3 coach beats in order, clock frozen until dismissed
tests.invariant: On a fresh boot coach_1 fires and decisionRemaining drifts <0.5s over 3s until dismissal, coach_1/2/3/coach_done appear strictly in order, the clock drains >=1.5s over 2s afterwards, and maybeStartCoach never re-fires (coach_1 count stays 1, localStorage bjj-neural-coached=='1').

tests.title: film study: watchShort fires the beat; player onError falls back without crashing
tests.invariant: watchShort(0) returns ok and emits short_watched under a stubbed YT player, and invoking the player's captured onError closure opens exactly one fallback link and removes all .ngPlayerHost elements without throwing.

tests.title: JIT sheet drill pumps the odds odometer and the canvas edge
tests.invariant: Three reveal->Got-it grades in the expand sheet raise the target's displayed odds by >=17 points with the [data-odds] odometer within 1 of the live odds, emit jit_opened plus >=3 bonus_pumped beats, and executing from the same sheet reaches impact_success.

tests.title: drilling refunds decision time, capped at 2 per window
tests.invariant: The first two JIT grades each refund >=2s of decisionRemaining, the third refunds <1s, and the three timer_refund beats carry granted [true, true, false].

tests.title: expiry narrates 3-2-1 and auto-picks with a pop (no silent teleport)
tests.invariant: Letting the decision window expire emits both expiry_warning and auto_pick beats (the auto-pick is narrated, never a silent teleport).

tests.title: honest economy: revealing a card is 'seen', only grading credits mastery
tests.invariant: noteCardSeen leaves masteredCount unchanged, three prep-grades raise prep to >=3 while masteredCount stays flat, and only pushing rec to 3 raises masteredCount by >=1 (mastery is recall-gated).

tests.title: fresh card renders 4 MC options, clamped, with the mc_shown beat
tests.invariant: Presenting a fresh MC-able card renders exactly 4 visible [data-mc-opt] options each <=170 chars, emits mc_shown, and _mc.correct is a valid index in [0,4).

tests.title: MC options are deterministic under rig across two boots
tests.invariant: Two fresh boots with identical deep mc-pick/mc-shuffle rig queues render identical [data-mc-opt] text lists.

tests.title: wrong answer: no credit, no stage, correct revealed
tests.invariant: Clicking a wrong MC option emits mc_wrong, leaves prep unchanged and the card's stage at 0, and the correct button gains data-mc-result='correct'.

tests.title: correct answer: full credit + stage, graduating to recall at stage 2
tests.invariant: The first correct MC click adds prep+1 and stage 1 (mc_correct + bonus_pumped), the second correct reaches stage 2, and re-presenting the card then renders recall with zero [data-mc-opt] elements.

tests.title: mastered only via recall: MC caps at the gate, recall mints rec
tests.invariant: Five consecutive MC corrects pin the card's stage at 2 with rec still 0, while recall-grading three distinct graduated cards raises rec to >=3 and masteredCount by >=1.

tests.title: graded tiers: plausible = no credit + close feedback, trap = stage penalty
tests.invariant: Picking the plausible tier emits mc_wrong with tier 'plausible' and no prep credit, and after one correct (stage 1) picking the trap tier emits mc_wrong with tier 'trap' and knocks the stage back to 0.

tests.title: mcMode setting: classic kills MC; mc still caps the stage at 2
tests.invariant: With mcMode 'classic' no [data-mc-opt] renders, and with mcMode 'mc' a stage-2 card may present as MC but a correct answer still leaves the stage capped at 2.

tests.title: keyboard digits answer MC and never leak into the roll options
tests.invariant: Pressing the digit key of the correct MC option emits mc_correct without opening a roll-option expand sheet (_detailCtx stays falsy).

tests.title: a11y: radiogroup semantics and a live result region
tests.invariant: The MC block renders a visible role='radiogroup' containing exactly 4 [data-mc-opt][role='radio'] buttons plus at least one aria-live='polite' region.

tests.title: one-beacon law: MC never claims the beacon
tests.invariant: Answering an MC card leaves at most one [data-beacon] on the page and the beacon target is never 'mc' or 'mc-opt'.

tests.title: recall fallback: a card with <2 viable distractors renders classic recall
tests.invariant: When the deck is poisoned so pooling cannot find 2 viable distractors, the presented card renders classic recall: zero [data-mc-opt] elements and _mc null.

tests.title: checkpoint is now a real MC quiz: pass marks the unit
tests.invariant: With unit-1 lessons seeded done, answering every checkpoint card correctly via the truth rail emits checkpoint_passed and unit_done and sets the unit row's data-done to '1'.

tests.title: checkpoint fail links the weakest lesson
tests.invariant: Answering every checkpoint card wrong emits checkpoint_failed (and never checkpoint_passed) whose weakest field is a string naming one of the unit's lesson deckKeys.

tests.title: payload wiring: graded traps + tooltip detail actually ship (were 0 before)
tests.invariant: The shipped flashcards.json payload carries more than 100 cards with authored mc distractor tiers and more than 1000 cards with the full-detail d field.

tests.title: golden card: one-line options + authored plausible/trap tiers, straight from the payload
tests.invariant: The golden Upa Escape card ships a <=36-char answer line, >=3 authored distractors, and a longer d field, and presents as 4 rendered options each <=36 chars (after stripping the number badge) whose tier map includes both 'trap' and 'plausible'.

tests.title: recall reveal: one-liner answer + a 'More detail' tooltip expanding the full explanation
tests.invariant: A graduated golden card's recall reveal shows a [data-mc-more] toggle with .mcDetail hidden by default, and clicking it reveals detail text longer than the 36-char one-line budget.

tests.title: opponent finish attempt emits opponent_attack with the technique
tests.invariant: A rigged opponent finish emits opponent_attack whose technique is a non-empty string and whose idx resolves to a submissions node carrying exactly that title.

tests.title: opponent positional counter emits opponent_move (and no phantom attack)
tests.invariant: With the finish declined, opponent_move carries a truthful technique/idx resolving to a transitions-or-submissions node, and zero opponent_attack beats are emitted.

tests.title: boot({initialState}) seeds progress before the app reads storage
tests.invariant: boot({initialState}) with prep['Mount|Top']=3 is visible to the app at first read: prep equals 3 and masteredCount() equals 1.

tests.title: stale-seed hygiene: a later un-seeded boot starts clean
tests.invariant: An un-seeded boot following a seeded one starts with zero prep keys — the earlier initialState never leaks forward.

tests.title: curriculum.json is hermetic: deterministic response, never off-box
tests.invariant: An in-page fetch of /static/neural/curriculum.json resolves on-box with status 200 or a clean 404 (never rejected or aborted off-box).

tests.title: restart mid-defense: no ghost tap, no ladder drop, defense state fully disarmed
tests.invariant: resetRoll while caught clears _defendSub, _panicKey, and the vignette, keeps the ladder rank unchanged with zero defeat_drain/ladder_down beats, and the new roll lands (>=2 land beats) with live options and no [data-panic] card.

tests.title: restart mid-sweep: the cancelled needle does not haunt the canvas
tests.invariant: resetRoll mid tension-sweep nulls _sweep and no additional sweep_land beat ever fires afterward (the cancelled needle never lands).

tests.title: odds refresh routes back to normal math after a defense is abandoned
tests.invariant: After a defense is abandoned via resetRoll, refreshOptionOdds leaves every visible option card's displayed % exactly equal to Math.round(moveChance*100) — zero mismatches (no residual escape-math routing).

tests.title: abandoned checkpoint does not contaminate the next deck or auto-pass the unit
tests.invariant: Closing the deck mid-checkpoint clears _checkpoint, and MC answers in a subsequently opened lesson deck never emit checkpoint_passed/unit_done nor mark the unit's checkpoint done.

tests.title: starting a roll clears an open checkpoint quiz
tests.invariant: Calling resetRoll while a checkpoint quiz is open clears _checkpoint to falsy.

tests.title: re-clicking Checkpoint mid-quiz does not silently reset progress
tests.invariant: Re-invoking startCheckpoint mid-quiz leaves _checkpoint.i at its advanced value (>=1) instead of resetting to card 0.

tests.title: mastered is not inflatable: rec counts DISTINCT cards proven by recall
tests.invariant: Recall-grading the same card five times raises rec by at most 1, while recalling three distinct graduated cards raises rec to >=3.

tests.title: prod-path rails exist: sound.destroy, save flush, tracked MC-advance timer
tests.invariant: sound.destroy and _flushSave exist as functions, set() stamps _settingsAt.mcMode with a number, and _flushSave synchronously persists a rec mutation into the bjj-neural-progress localStorage blob.

tests.title: the ring buffer logs patches for gameplay beats
tests.invariant: Grading a card grows sound.soundLog and the latest bonus_pumped entry carries a non-empty patch string.

tests.title: a rigged win plays the victory fanfare
tests.invariant: A rigged submission win logs a victory_cascade voice whose patch contains 'fanfare'.

tests.title: sound off: the log goes silent
tests.invariant: With the sound setting 'off', drilling two cards adds zero entries to the sound log.

tests.title: volume setting rides every logged voice
tests.invariant: After setting soundVolume to 0.8, the next logged voice's volume equals 0.8 to 5 decimal places.

tests.title: same-beat dedupe: two identical beats within 100ms log one voice
tests.invariant: Two identical fx('bonus_pumped') beats fired back-to-back log exactly one voice (same-beat dedupe).

tests.title: no AudioContext is ever created under test
tests.invariant: After gameplay that produced a non-empty soundLog, sound._ctxCreated is false — no AudioContext is constructed under test.

tests.title: sharpness decays per landing, mastery persists
tests.invariant: One JIT grade yields bonusSplit mastery 0.03 and sharpness 0.10 (displayed odds +>=12), and after the next successful landing sharpness decays to 0.075 while mastery stays 0.03.

tests.title: impact contrast: tension sweep, detonation on hit, hit-stop on miss
tests.invariant: A rigged hit orders sweep_start < sweep_land(inBand true) < detonation < impact_success with a 0.9-1.4s envelope and a positive band, and the following rigged miss lands out of band followed by hit_stop with zero detonation beats.

tests.title: victory cascade ≤1.5s on win; defeat drain on loss; ladder survives reload
tests.invariant: A rigged win emits victory_cascade with durMs <=1500 and ladder_up (+1 rank), the rank survives a preserveStorage reload, and a defense-expiry loss then emits defeat_drain and ladder_down (-1 rank).

tests.title: film-study first look: +4% once per technique, never stacking
tests.invariant: The first watchShort on a technique raises its displayed odds by exactly 4 points with a single film_first_look beat, and a second watch leaves the delta at 4 and the beat count at 1.

tests.title: journey recorder: captures actions and rng draws for replay authoring
tests.invariant: startRecording then gameplay then stopRecording returns {startedAt: number, beats: array, draws: array} containing the commit beat and a resolve-tagged draw, and a second stopRecording returns null (the window is closed).

tests.title: white belt study story: path → lesson → MC → recall → checkpoint → unit complete → persists
tests.invariant: One continuous session drives wrong-then-right MC (mc_wrong then mc_correct + bonus_pumped), lesson_done for every unit-1 lesson, a recall grade minting rec+1, checkpoint_passed and unit_done with unit 2 unlocked, and after a preserveStorage reload the unit row stays data-done='1' with rec>=1 on a v2 blob.

evidence.redProof: Mutated line 101 from `expectAllBars(frozen, "paused")` to `expectAllBars(frozen, "running")`. FAILED at line 70 — Expected: running, Received: paused (coach pauses every .ngbar under the freeze). Restored from backup (sha256 92ed63aa3e303edeabb8fc572c4076c574ef4969ed9cee35f0c52821c7a1ff81); both green (26.9s).

tests.title: checkpoint quiz is untimed: 45s pump fires no expiry beats, i moves only on answers, quiz stays live
tests.invariant: With a checkpoint quiz open the roll's decision clock is frozen: no expiry_warning/auto_pick fires, _checkpoint.i moves only on answers, and the quiz UI is never clobbered by background auto-play.

evidence.promoted: Q002 fixed in v1.67.7 (_tickDecision checkpoint guard); born-red spec green post-fix (4.2s)

tests.invariant: Garbage in bjj-neural-ladder degrades to a clean rank-1 start without crashing and is quarantined: the app boots and plays with rank 1, a rigged win writes a valid rank-2 record, and after a preserveStorage reload the key JSON.parses cleanly at rank 2 — the poison never resurfaces.
